# Audit: phase or change title

- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Auditor:** name/agent
- **Scope:** branch/commit/PR link
- **Approved plan:** link
- **Acceptance criteria:** link

## Summary

State whether the change meets the approved scope and criteria. Do not imply tests ran if they did not.

## Findings

For each finding, record:

- **Severity:** critical / high / medium / low
- **Location:** file and line or user flow
- **Evidence:** what was observed
- **Impact:** what can go wrong
- **Correction:** smallest safe fix

## Checks reviewed

| Check | Result | Evidence or reason not run |
|---|---|---|
| Scope and approval | not checked / pass / finding | |
| Correctness and edge cases | not checked / pass / finding | |
| Privacy and security | not checked / pass / finding | |
| Accessibility | not checked / pass / finding | |
| Tests and claims | not checked / pass / finding | |
| Documentation and evidence | not checked / pass / finding | |

## Disposition

- [ ] Findings fixed and re-reviewed
- [ ] Owner accepted listed non-critical limitations
- [ ] Phase not ready for acceptance

**Owner decision and date:** [pending / decision]
